chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Disbanding and heading east, meeting Basie in Kansas City
summary: Offered a place by Willie Bryant, he disbanded, gave his book to Eddie Beal, and drove east, stopping in Kansas City where he met Basie.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well I tell you, after I made some arrangements for Willie, he offered me a job if I wanted to come to New York, and I did want
to come to New York. I could have come and played in his band.

And so I told him yes, I'd be glad to, But I had to disband my band in California. So I disbanded and I turned my whole repertoire over to Eddy Beale. And that's the last, I don't think Eddy ever did anything with that. That's the last, there went, Alice Blue Gown and all the other things that I had written.
So I left California by car and I got as far as Kansas City. That's when I ran into Basie. I ran into the Count.
